name: STROKE OF GENIUS
notes: 1911 Mona Lisa theft, 1889 Saint-Remy Starry Night, 1893 Scream, Nan Wood + dentist McKeeby models, 1656 Las Meninas all verified; textbook ladder.

name: PALETTE CLEANSERS
notes: Four-year Sistine fresco for Julius II, Kahlo bus crash and double Rivera marriage, 'Jack the Dripper', Gentileschi's Judith all accurate.

name: MYTH DEMEANORS
notes: Aphrodite sea-foam/Cyprus/golden apple, Hephaestus=Vulcan, Leto bearing the twins on Delos all correct; Leto is a strong hard-but-gettable $1000.

name: HERO WORSHIP
notes: Nemean lion as first labor, shield-mirror Perseus, dragon's teeth and bronze-hoofed bulls for Jason, Bellerophon/Pegasus/Chimera all correct.

name: COMMANDER IN BRIEF
notes: 'Only 19th century' qualifier keeps the Cleveland clue evergreen; Polk's 49th-parallel Oregon settlement and Fillmore as last Whig president both accurate.

name: POTUS OPERANDI
notes: Jefferson's epitaph omitting the presidency, Taft's 1921 chief justiceship, Coolidge's lamplight oath from his notary father all verified.

name: THE CAT'S MEOW
notes: $600 leaked the answer ('Isle of Man' -> Manx, Pad Thai-class partial-word leak); re-clued with genuine Ark-door folklore leaving the isle unnamed; Bastet/Bubastis and vibrissae/vibrare correct; re-scored 47.

name: PUP QUIZ
notes: Dalmatia as Croatian coast, Chihuahua as Mexico's largest state, Togo & Balto as Siberian huskies, yodeling basenji, Laika Nov 1957 first-to-orbit all accurate.

name: FAITH ACCOMPLI
notes: Ramadan fast, eight-day oil miracle, 'awakened one', Guru Granth Sahib, Ahura Mazda all solid; rows 1-3 lean easy but the ladder still climbs to Zoroastrianism.

name: PROPHET MARGINS
notes: Jonah/Nineveh, Gabriel in the cave near Mecca, Daniel clued without the label some traditions dispute, Elijah's whirlwind-plus-chariot wording all precise.

name: PARTY ANIMALS
notes: Nast elephant, 1782 Great Seal eagle, Jackson 'jackass' donkey, gallus/Gaul rooster pun all correct; bulldog and eagle stretch the 'party' premise a bit and low rows are flat.

name: GODS OF COMMERCE
notes: Ajax cleanser named for the Trojan-war hero web-verified; Pandora's jar (not box) and Versace's Medusa emblem correct; 'Gianni' first-name hint is deliberate eponym style.
